text:
Jordan R: Heads up eu-west1c: kube-scheduler is seeing a jump in tiny GPU pods Pending and eviction rate creeping up.
Priya S: Yep, noticed attach RPC latency spiking during the scale window :grimacing: looks like nat/egress pressure.
Linh: Pulled NAT metrics — conntrack count ~110k (limit 120k) and ephemeral port churn on nat-1.
Nate: Attach helper logs show EPIPE/504s then kubelet retries; pods hold GPU slot while waiting -> fragmentation + preempt churn.
Jordan R: quick snippet of pod state I grabbed: ```
# kubectl get pods -n ml-prod | grep Pending | wc -l
172
```
infra-bot: [alert] eu-west1c nat-gateway-1 conntrack_util=91% port_saturation=78% at 18:12 UTC
Priya S: Quick mitigations? We can either smooth scaler bursts or beef up NAT capacity.
Linh: Short-term: add a token-bucket limiter to the ml-scale-controller for region bursts and add 20s jitter to instance launches.
Nate: Also consider a warm-pool per GPU SKU (small-gpu vs large-gpu) so tiny pods hit warmed nodes instead of cold attach.
Jordan R: Could we also label nodes with good egress health and have scheduler prefer that label for small pods?
Priya S: Yeah: nodeLabel fast-egress=true set by infra probe, scheduler soft-prefer for tiny-gpu workload. Low risk.
Linh: I'll open the scaler PR with token bucket + jitter. Canary to 10% of region first.
Nate: Infra action: request extra NAT capacity & increase ephemeral port range on nat-1; long term move attach RPCs off shared NAT.
infra-bot: Incident INC-8892 created: nat-capacity request submitted to cloud-infra.
Jordan R: Cost tradeoff: warm-pool per-sku ~+9% for eu-west1c at peak but should cut preempt churn and requeues.
Priya S: I'll own warm-pool config change and post cost estimate on ops board.
Linh: Plan of attack: 1) PR limiter/jitter (Linh) 2) warm-pool per-sku (Priya) 3) nat capacity inc (Nate/infra) 4) synthetic burst test (Jordan).
ops-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-attach — recommends nat scaling and warm-pool adjustments.
Nate: Long-term: provision dedicated control-plane attach VMs or private LB so attach RPCs don't compete with worker egress.
Jordan R: After we roll the limiter and bump warm pool, run a 200-pod burst and watch attach_rpc_95pct, preempt_rate, and pending count.
Priya S: Adding alert: attach_rpc_95pct > 1s triggers paging.
Linh: Canary deployed to eu-west1c canary pool in ~5m, will report metrics to this thread.
Nate: If canary looks stable, expand region-wide and then measure fragmentation delta.
Jordan R: Thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
